rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a supermarket in everyday Hong Kong Cantonese.

example.english: Let's go to the supermarket to buy groceries first.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 ciu1 si5 maai5 sung3 sin1

rows.note: Use this full form when you want to spell out the term rather than use the common abbreviation 超市.

example.english: The vegetables at this supermarket are very fresh.
example.traditional: 呢間超級市場啲菜好新鮮。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 di1 coi3 hou2 san1 sin1
